_contract: See references/narration.md. A provider receives UTF-8 text and returns a mono PCM16 WAV plus a version-1 sample timeline with word and phrase records. Provider-specific timing evidence (for example phoneme durations) stays in its own sidecar files.

segment_limits.reason: one Kokoro inference batch per segment (the provider rejects longer input)

hi-IN.status: experimentally validated; native listening and human timing review pending

segment_limits.reason: one model piece (at most 400 phonemes) per segment; the provider rejects longer input

te-IN.status: synthesis (P015.2A) and native word/phrase timing (P015.2B) technically validated; native listening and word-boundary review pending

kn-IN.status: synthesis and native word/phrase timing technically validated (P016); native listening and word-boundary review pending

ta-IN.status: synthesis and native word/phrase timing technically validated (P016); native listening and word-boundary review pending

en-IN.status: synthesis and native word/phrase timing technically validated (P016; apostrophe contractions use group reconciliation); Indian English accent, listening and word-boundary review pending

hi-IN.status: synthesis and native word/phrase timing technically validated (P016) as an alternative to kokoro-onnx; native listening and word-boundary review pending

mithi.note: Mithi v2 Flash (pinned revision) on CPU inside WSL2. Words and phrases are timed from the model's own token durations and token-to-word ownership (mithi_mapping.py); inconsistent mappings are rejected, never estimated. Locales te-IN, kn-IN, ta-IN, en-IN and hi-IN are each validated through this provider on their own samples; further Mithi languages need their own entry and validation.
